Train 2: Leaves city B at 9:30, speed = 100 km/h, heading toward A

Let t be the time in hours after 9:00 when they meet.

Train 1 travels for t hours at 80 km/h, so distance from A = 80t km.
Train 2 travels for (t - 0.5) hours at 100 km/h (since it leaves at 9:30), so distance from B = 100(t - 0.5) km.

When they meet: 80t + 100(t - 0.5) = 300
80t + 100t - 50 = 300
180t = 350
t = 350/180 = 35/18 ≈ 1.944 hours = 1 hour 56.67 minutes

So they meet at approximately 9:00 + 1h 56.67min ≈ 10:57 AM.
